whyVietnam.subtitle: The second-largest apparel and footwear exporter in the world, and the fastest-growing electronics and furniture base in Southeast Asia.

fta.label: Free-trade agreements
fta.body: EVFTA, CPTPP, UKVFTA and RCEP remove or reduce duties in the EU, UK, Japan, Canada, Australia and more.

cost.label: Lower labour cost than China
cost.body: Competitive wages with rapidly improving productivity and automation in export zones.

workforce.label: Working-age workforce
workforce.body: Young, literate and experienced in export manufacturing; median age of 33.

sectors.label: Annual exports
sectors.body: Electronics, apparel, footwear, furniture, machinery, seafood, coffee and packaging lead the way.

tradeAssurance.body: Deposits and balances are held in a segregated account at a licensed Vietnamese partner bank and released only when delivery milestones are confirmed. CANG never holds client money.
tradeAssurance.point1: Funds held by a licensed partner bank, not by CANG
tradeAssurance.point2: Release on shipment documents or delivery confirmation

services.subtitle: Everything after the quotation, handled by licensed partners inside your order.

logistics.title: Logistics
logistics.body: Sea, air and rail freight quotes from partner forwarders, customs brokerage and insurance, tracked milestone by milestone.

inspection.title: Quality inspection
inspection.body: Factory audits and pre-shipment inspections with AQL sampling, reports uploaded to your order within 24 hours.

financing.title: Trade financing
financing.body: Working-capital and production financing for factories, import financing for buyers — from regulated lenders.
